''See also: [[Elders Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Elders are ancient, eternal entities possessing immense power over fundamental forces such as time, space, memory, knowledge, and the cycle of life and death. While some view them as mythical bogeymen or extinct spirits, they are real beings that exist around humanity. They range from strange, non-malicious creatures known as [[Elderspawn]] to the immensely powerful [[Great Elders]]. These [[Great Elders]] are often described as alien, grotesque, or even monstrous, and their mentalities are so foreign to humans that attempting to perceive their true thoughts can cause madness. They primarily utilize containers to manifest their powers rather than acting directly. The [[Great Elders]] are characterized by their unique, individual purposes and often operate independently of one another. Known individuals include Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut, who seeks knowledge; [[Nakothi]], who pursues a balance of life and death; [[Urg’naut]], who seeks nothingness; Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos, who pursues change; the [[Dead Mother]], who attempts to remake humanity into monsters; [[Kelarac]], who manages souls and is viewed by some as a potential benefactor; and [[Kthanikahr]], who desires to replace humans with [[worms]]. Despite their differing goals, they share a collective desire to escape their current existence, which they view as a prison, by passing through a [[crack in the sky]] to ascend beyond this world. Some believe they intend to reclaim the world or destroy The Empire{{!}}the Empire, while others suggest they simply wish to leave. Humanity's relationship with the Elders is deeply divided. The [[Blackwatch]] group captures and studies them, while a group called the [[Sleepless]] seeks to communicate with them to gain wisdom for mankind. Conversely, groups like the [[Luminian Order]] encourage hatred of these beings. The Emperor and others warn that the Elders seek to corrupt human leaders to gain control over the race. Although they can be killed when in human form, it is believed that even if destroyed, the [[Great Elders]] will eventually return.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Elders are strange, eternal beings whose existence is documented in ancient accounts that have often been questioned. Stirring within the [[Aion]] and beyond, these entities possess powers far exceeding human control and can perceive unalloyed truth through [[Intent]]. While the [[Blackwatch]] works to defend the realm against them, it is noted that some [[Guilds]] may operate under their influence and certain [[Watchmen]] might serve as their [[acolytes]]. Their activity has increased following the disappearance of the Emperor, yet their actions often appear to lack rhyme or reason. Prolonged exposure to their voices can induce madness, and they possess the ability to be bound into ships using [[blood]], bone, or specific artifacts.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Driven by the belief that they will provide salvation, some individuals join cults dedicated to the Elders. This tentacled group performs foul incursions and has even deployed agents to spy on Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss. While they can function as either partners or parasites, the Elders have a history of engaging in war when their plans diverge. They are responsible for the crack appearing in the sky and have orchestrated a scheme involving the [[Optasia]] and the death of the Emperor. Ultimately, these entities may simply be playing games as they work toward their goal of consuming humankind, forcing The Empire{{!}}the Empire to defend the world against them.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Some people join [[Elder cults]] because they believe the [[Elders]] will save them.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c1">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 1</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Elders]] sent something to spy on Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Elders]] and their spawn perform foul incursions.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Elders]] are a group associated with tentacles.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c10">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Empire]] must defend the world from [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elders]] can be used as partners or parasites.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Elders]] have gone to war before when plans diverged.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The appearance of the [[crack in the sky]] is known to be caused by [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Elders]] have a plan involving the [[Optasia]] and the Emperor's death.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14" />}}</li>

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Though many believe the Elders to be extinct, these authors of darkness are beginning to move once more. Described as serpents that utilize seduction, illusion, and deception, they possess the terrifying capability to crack the sky. Because of this threat, the Emperor seeks to prevent their rise and ensure The Empire{{!}}the Empire is strong enough to face them. Consequently, the Elders have become a high priority for all.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Emperor seeks to prevent the rise of the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elders]] are considered by many to be extinct.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c5">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Deception, illusion, and seduction are the ways of the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Elders]] are described as serpents and authors of darkness.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Elders]] are capable of cracking the sky.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c10">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Elders]] are a high priority for all.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[The Empire]] needs to be strong enough to face down the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Elders]] are moving.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Originating from the void, the Elders are an alien group that communicates through a collective chorus. Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine identifies them as the cause of recent strange occurrences, which include the tearing of the sky in half. Although [[Calder]] faced accusations of collaborating with them, he ultimately intended to oppose the group and withheld certain knowledge from them. While a woman attempted to sell [[Calder]] to these beings, it was revealed that the Elders seek escape rather than [[destruction]] and are not inherently evil toward humanity.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine attributes the strange events to [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Elders]] are tearing the sky in half.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Elders]] speak in a chorus.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Elders]] sprung from the void.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elders]] are a group [[Calder]] was accused of collaborating with.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Elders]] are alien to humanity but not evil.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] intends to oppose the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void is the home of the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] kept knowledge secret from the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Elders]] want to escape rather than destroy.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The woman intended to sell [[Calder]] to [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
